blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Charlito Martin R. Mendoza took his oath as Commissioner of the Bureau of Customs (BOC) Friday, following his appointment by President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. He returns to the BOC after leading major reforms at the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR). Before becoming BIR Commissioner, he served as Department of Finance undersecretary for the Revenue Operations Group from April 2024 to November 2025, overseeing the revenue operations and collection performance of both the BIR and BOC. He previously served as district collector of the BOC Port of Cebu from July 2019 to October 2022, where he led improvements […]...
